title: Help & Support
description: Help center, usage tips, and complete guide
contactSupportDesc: Contact our support team for help and questions
beforeContactTip1: Make sure you have read the documentation and usage tips
beforeContactTip2: Prepare detailed information about the issue you are experiencing
beforeContactTip3: Screenshots or videos can help the troubleshooting process
beforeContactTip4: Note the WhatsApp Business number and WABA account having issues
usageTipsDesc: Complete guide to maximize platform usage
setupTip1Desc: Use WhatsApp Business or a number that is not yet registered.
setupTip2Desc: Complete your profile with logo, description, address, and operating hours to increase customer trust.
templatesTip1Desc: Create templates with specific purposes: order notifications, reminders, promos, etc.
templatesTip2Desc: Don't use words like "FREE!!!", "CLICK NOW", or too many emojis.
templatesTip3Desc: Give users the option to stop receiving promotional messages.
messagingTip1Desc: After a user sends a message, you have 24 hours to reply freely. After that, you can only use approved templates.
messagingTip2Desc: Limit marketing broadcasts to a maximum of 1-2 times per week to avoid spam reports.
messagingTip3Desc: Use variables like name, order number, etc. to make messages more personal.
qualityTip1Desc: Check quality rating on the Quality page to ensure GREEN (Connected) status.
qualityTip2Desc: Fast response time increases engagement and reduces block rate.
qualityTip3Desc: Ensure all contacts you reach out to have given consent/permission.
aiTip1Desc: Upload PDF containing FAQ, product catalog, or business information for AI knowledge base.
aiTip2Desc: Define AI personality and rules so answers match your brand voice.
aiTip3Desc: Add filters to prevent AI from answering sensitive questions or those outside business context.
